analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($31,095) vs SMA5 ($32,703)/SMA20 ($34,962)/SMA50 ($43,854) — below short-term and mid-term trends.
· Position relative to SMA100 ($40,972)/SMA200 ($31,856) — weak long-term trend.
· 52-week position (46.9%) + current price range represents a historically neutral zone.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (29.4→41.1) — exiting oversold, weak recovery in upward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-1024.9→201.6) — improving from bearish territory, attempting a rebound after a death cross.
· Bollinger Band current price position (mid-band $34,962) — band width at 46.78% indicates a high volatility zone.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($29,075) — higher than Pivot S1 ($23,068).
· Swing resistance ($35,220) — close to SMA20 ($34,962), potential trend reversal if broken.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low forming) — confirmation of higher low formation.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.83x) — below average volume, reduced confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase) — RSI recovery and MACD improvement signals present, but maintaining a wait-and-see approach due to lack of volume and trading below SMA200.
